schema.name: catalog
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE catalog(product_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,merchant_index INTEGER,title TEXT,price_cents INTEGER,channel3_id TEXT,source TEXT)

schema.name: customers
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE customers(customer_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,segment TEXT,purchases INTEGER,last_purchase_day INTEGER)

schema.name: merchants
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE merchants(merchant_index INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,name TEXT,stock INTEGER,max_offer_pct INTEGER)

schema.name: metadata
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE metadata(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,value TEXT)

schema.name: observations
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE observations(action_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,day INTEGER,customer_id TEXT,selected_action TEXT,propensity REAL,matures_day INTEGER,reward_cents INTEGER,bias REAL,recency_30d REAL,purchases_7d REAL,offers_7d REAL,price_scale REAL,observed_merchant_affinity REAL,recent_refunds REAL)

schema.name: orders
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE orders(order_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,day INTEGER,merchant_index INTEGER,customer_id TEXT,gross_cents INTEGER,observed_refund_cents INTEGER,modeled_fee_cents INTEGER,processing_cents INTEGER)

output.description: Only observed events. reward_cents NULL means immature. orders.observed_refund_cents is incomplete for recent orders. Currency: simulated USD cents. Catalog provenance is cached Channel3.
